blocks.text: Transgenic janwar mein bahar se dala gaya (foreign) gene hota hai jo matloob protein banata hai. Transgenic janwar kai kaamon mein aate hain, maslan dawaen banana, paidawar (yield) barhana, bimariyon ke khilaf muzahimat (resistance) barhana waghaira. Misalein:

items: Transgenic doodh dene wali gaayon mein insaan ke genes hain taa ke woh aisa doodh dein jo kitab ke mutabiq insaan ki maa ke doodh jaisa hai.
Transgenic bakriyan aisa doodh deti hain jis mein makri ke jaale jaise mazboot resham (silk) proteins hote hain.
Transgenic bakriyan apne doodh mein insaan ka enzyme lysozyme bhi banati hain jo insaanon mein dast (diarrhoea) paida karne wale bacteria se larta hai.
Transgenic machhliyan behtar barhti hain, kam khurak khati hain, zyada sardi bardasht karti hain aur bimariyon ka muqabla karti hain.

Gene therapy mein genetically modified viruses ke zariye insaanon tak genes pohanchaye jate hain taa ke moroosi (inheritable) bimariyan theek hon, maslan T aur B cells ki ghalat nashonuma aur moroosi andhapan.

Transgenic bakri se banne wali pehli insani biological dawa aik anticoagulant (khoon jamne se rokne wali dawa) thi, jo operation ya bachche ki paidaish ke dauran khoon ke lothre banne ka imkaan kam karti hai.
Laboratory mein malaria se mehfooz machhar banaye gaye hain; un mein aisa gene dala gaya hai jo un ke andar Plasmodium ki nashonuma kam karta hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit (dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Nazariyati taur par bahar ke genes insaan ke germline cells (jin se gametes bante hain) ya somatic cells (jism ke baqi cells) mein dale ja sakte hain. Agar germline cells mein genes dale jayen to tabdeeli agli naslon tak jati hai. Is liye khatraat aur akhlaqi (ethical) masail ki wajah se zyada tar research somatic cells par hui hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit (dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: 1980s ke wast (mid-1980s) se transgenic choohe (mice) bimariyon ki tehqeeq ka aham model hain. Choohe is liye model hain ke un ke genome sequence ka mukammal tajziya ho chuka hai aur un ka genome insaan ke genome se bohat milta julta hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Transgenic gaayen asal mein insaan ke doodh ke sirf kuch proteins (maslan lactoferrin ya lysozyme) banati hain; un ka doodh har lehaz se insaan ke doodh jaisa nahin hota.

blocks.prompt: Insaanon mein gene research zyada tar germline ke bajaye somatic cells par kyun hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: Germline cells ki tabdeeli agli naslon tak jati hai, jis mein khatraat aur akhlaqi masail hain; somatic cells ki tabdeeli sirf ilaaj wale shakhs tak rehti hai.

items: Transgenic janwar bahar ke gene se matloob protein banata hai.
Misalein: insaani genes wali gaayen, silk aur lysozyme wala bakri ka doodh, behtar machhliyan, gene therapy, bakri se anticoagulant, malaria se mehfooz machhar.
Research zyada tar somatic cells par; transgenic choohe bimariyon ki tehqeeq ka model.
